items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes cohomological descent for the comparison between the qc and topological realisations of a locally quasi-compact space (statement lines 8092-8099). The proof (proof lines 8101-8125) reduces to a single sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma, uses the description of the pullback along pi_X to rewrite the composite, and degenerates the relative Leray spectral sequence using the vanishing for the two factors epsilon_X and pi_X. H2: one reduction plus one spectral-sequence degeneration, written out.
